plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.200-202. Courses marked * in the catalog require admission to the Educator Preparation Program (ECM 2301, ECM 3700, ECM 3701, EDU 3300, EDU 4000, EDU 4930, EDU 4940). The catalog notes graduation may require more than the minimum 124 credit hours for students desiring NCDPI licensure. A course may be used to satisfy only one requirement within the major, as printed.
